verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships first-party iOS and Android SDKs. A hands-on community report says the iOS library auto-reports fatal errors, and the docs reference iOS app-hang capture and Android/iOS SDK features. Events can be correlated by device and filtered by release, and the CLI uploads files to improve stack traces, so some reproduction context is evidenced. missing for 10: any evidence of NDK/native C/C++ crash capture, explicit documentation of Android crash capture, explicit documentation of the device/OS/app-version metadata attached to crash events, independent hands-on corroboration beyond one early iOS comment.
